test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

"He will submit the report by Friday."

options.text: The report is submitted by him by Friday.
The report will have been submitted by him.
The report submitted by him by Friday.
The report will be submitted by him by Friday.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The active sentence provided is: **"He will submit the report by Friday."**
 
• To convert the sentence into passive voice, the object **"the report"** becomes the subject of the sentence.
 
• The correct passive form uses the structure: **"will be + past participle"** (submit → submitted).
 
• Thus, the passive form is: **"The report will be submitted by him by Friday."**

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Passive Sentence:** *"The report will be submitted by him by Friday."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "The report is submitted by him by Friday." – Incorrect because "is submitted" implies present tense, not future tense.
 
• **Option 2:** "The report will have been submitted by him." – Incorrect because "will have been submitted" is future perfect tense and does not match the structure of the given sentence.
 
• **Option 3:** "The report submitted by him by Friday." – Incorrect because it lacks the auxiliary verb "will be," making the sentence incomplete.
 
• **Option 4:** "The report will be submitted by him by Friday." – Correct as it follows the correct passive voice structure.
 
• **Option 5:** – No relevant information provided for evaluation.
